violations.text: The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -bread unit shelf -door of refrigerator across from cookline -fan covers (kitchen freezer, walk-in cooler) Non-food contact surfaces shall be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Observed the dumpster outside located on (broken/crack cement with holes). The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 09/07/2026

The floors in the following areas has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -underneath cookline -ware washing area (including rubber mats) The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/06/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/04/2025

The floor and wall junctures in the following areas do not have coving. 1. Walk-in cooler (floor) 2. Prep Area (wall) 3. Ware washing area (floor) The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2025
